detail.body:
## Summary

The 13 published explainer videos are being re-voiced with Xiaoxiao, keeping every frame and swapping only the narration. That needed tooling fixes, and it taught the pronunciation lexicon a lot (the living-lexicon rule from #106 in action).

- **`scripts/revoice.sh <project>`**: one command per project.
  - Backs up the old state once to `revoice_backup/`.
  - Synthesizes the new take through the pronunciation layer. `SKIP_TTS=1` keeps the current take.
  - Restores the frames, then retimes them.
  - Runs the pause check, captions, font subset, assemble, lint and check.
  - Renders `renders/video_revoiced.mp4`; the original `renders/video.mp4` is never touched.
- **`retime_frames.py`**:
  - Frames now map through STORYBOARD.md `- src:`. NVFP4 has `19b-*/19c-*` frames that the NN+1 rule mis-mapped.
  - The registration regex accepts `=tl;` without spaces (PR 44051 frames).
  - `--chain` composes the new anchors through an existing WARP when the built take was lost by an earlier retime (PR 43238).
- **Pronunciation layer**:
  - A hyphen between two letters becomes a space (bit-exact, top-k).
  - Lexicon lookups fall back to case-insensitive (flashinfer).
  - New rules: number + GB/MB/TB/KB; Qwen → Kwen, also inside Qwen3-8B and Qwen-Image.
  - New respellings: SANA, epilogue, launch, denoise → 去噪, DeepSelect, hmax2, ctas.
  - **Readings the user picked by ear:** Qwen → Kwen, EAGLE → Eagle, RAGGED → Ragged. Kimi, PR and dB are approved as read.
  - `pron_check --meta` accepts a Chinese spoken form (去噪).
- **Docs**:
  - `references/pronunciation.md` gets new measurement rows, the user's picks, the listen-on-render list (Claude, Lean, README, TopK), and the note that in-context checks of long lines are noisy.
  - SKILL.md and troubleshooting document re-voicing.

## Verification

- `pytest`: 242 passed (7 pronunciation tests). `pre-commit` is clean.
- PR 43238 went through the whole path end to end, including `--chain`, and was rendered (83 s) and checked on QA sheets: animation, voice and captions stay in sync.
- **All 13 published videos were re-voiced and rendered** with `revoice.sh`:
  - 13/13 exited with rc=0; every frame of every project was retimed (9–54 frames per video).
  - Total length went from 132 min to 142.6 min. Xiaoxiao is about 8% slower than Yunyang.
  - Rendering ran at about 0.7–1.6× real time on an M4.
  - QA contact sheets of every video confirm that animation, voice and captions stay in sync.
  - The fixed cases rendered correctly:
    - NVFP4 `19b/19c` frames, mapped through the storyboard (43/43 retimed);
    - PR 44051 frames that register with `=tl;` and no spaces (46/46 retimed);
    - PR 43238 via `--chain` (cue times preserved through the old WARP).
- The run itself exercised the living-lexicon loop:
  - in-context Whisper checks of every line;
  - re-probing the FAILs in short sentences;
  - an A/B page for the brand words, where the user picked Kwen / Eagle / Ragged.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

+def interp(warp, t):
+    """Piecewise-linear [voiceTime, cueTime] lookup, clamped at both ends."""
+    if t <= warp[0][0]:

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Re-voice a finished video, keeping every frame: new take -> retime -> captions -> render.
+#   revoice.sh <project dir> [stop-after: tts|retime|check]      (VOICE=zh-CN-... to override,
+#   SKIP_TTS=1 to reuse the take already in audio_meta.json)
+# Writes renders/video_revoiced.mp4; never touches renders/video.mp4.
+# Safe to re-run: the old state is backed up once to revoice_backup/ and frames are restored from
+# it before every retime (a chained WARP must never be composed twice). A project whose built take
+# was lost by an earlier retime (no audio_meta.built.json) is chained through its existing WARP.
+set -euo pipefail
+source ~/.cache/sglang-explainer-video/env.sh
+P=$1
+STOP=${2:-}
+VOICE=${VOICE:-zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural}
+cd "$P"
+B=revoice_backup
+if [ ! -f $B/.done ]; then
+  mkdir -p $B
+  cp -R compositions $B/compositions
+  cp STORYBOARD.md SCRIPT.md audio_meta.json $B/
+  cp -R assets/voice $B/voice
+  if [ -f audio_meta.built.json ]; then cp audio_meta.built.json $B/; else touch $B/.chain; fi
+  touch $B/.done
+fi
+# reference take = the one the frames are cued to; without it (an earlier retime lost it) chain through WARP
+CHAIN=""
+if [ -f $B/.chain ]; then
+  cp $B/audio_meta.json audio_meta.built.json
+  CHAIN=--chain
+fi
+
+if [ "${SKIP_TTS:-0}" != 1 ]; then  # SKIP_TTS=1 keeps the take already in audio_meta.json
+sed -i.bak -E "s/^\*\*Voice:\*\* [^ ]+/**Voice:** $VOICE/" SCRIPT.md && rm -f SCRIPT.md.bak
+node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/audio.mjs --script ./SCRIPT.md --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --hyperframes . \
+  --out ./audio_meta.json --voice $VOICE 2>&1 | (grep -E "·|✓|✗|rror" || true) | cut -c1-220
+node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/audio.mjs sync-durations --audio-meta ./audio_meta.json --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md | tail -1
+cp audio_meta.json audio_meta.revoiced.json
+fi
+[ "$STOP" = tts ] && exit 0
+
+rm -rf compositions/frames && cp -R $B/compositions/frames compositions/frames
+$SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/retime_frames.py --project "$P" --ref-meta audio_meta.built.json $CHAIN | tail -3
+echo "retimed: $(grep -l 'var WARP = ' compositions/frames/*.html | wc -l | tr -d ' ') / $(ls compositions/frames/*.html | wc -l | tr -d ' ') frames"
+[ "$STOP" = retime ] && exit 0
+
+$SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/pron_check.py --meta audio_meta.json --hyperframes . | tail -4
+node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/captions.mjs build --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --audio-meta ./audio_meta.json \
+  --hyperframes . --out ./caption_groups.json 2>&1 | tail -2
+$SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/subset_fonts.py --project "$P" | tail -2
+node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/assemble-index.mjs --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --hyperframes . | tail -1
+node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/transitions.mjs inject --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --hyperframes . | tail -1
+node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/transitions.mjs verify --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --index ./index.html | tail -1
+hf lint 2>&1 | tail -1
+hf check 2>&1 | tail -1
+[ "$STOP" = check ] && exit 0
+
+hf render --skill=pr-to-video --quality high --output renders/video_revoiced.mp4 2>&1 | tail -2
+ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 renders/video_revoiced.mp4
+echo REVOICE_DONE

     assert spoken("吞吐 +5%，延迟 −12%") == "吞吐提升5%，延迟降低12%"
-    assert spoken("fused top-k 的 top-K") == "fused top k 的 top k"
+    assert spoken("fused top-k 的 top-K、bit-exact") == "fused top k 的 top K、bit exact"
+    assert spoken("flashinfer 和 8GB") == "Flash Infer 和 8 G B"
